goal: Stop misleading kernel API consumers into thinking they can instantiate independent loggers
Reflect that the underlying kernel logging system is inherently global across the process
reviewability: Reviewing the code is worthwhile now with no known blockers
agreement: Concept support because a single connection is simpler and pragmatic (sedited)
Objection that restricting the API is premature and hard to reverse was answered (ryanofsky)
